liturgicalDay.feastOrSaint: The Passion of Saint John the Baptist

verseOfDay.text: For Herod himself had sent and apprehended John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias the wife of Philip his brother, because he had married her.

prayer.title: Come, Holy Spirit
prayer.text:
Come, Holy Spirit,
fill the hearts of thy faithful
and kindle in them the fire of thy love.
Send forth thy Spirit and they shall be created,
and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

O God, who by the light of the Holy Spirit
didst instruct the hearts of the faithful,
grant that by the same Holy Spirit
we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in his consolation.
Through Christ our Lord.
Amen.
prayer.note: Before work you do not feel equal to.

consider.question: What is the point of the rosary if I keep getting distracted?
consider.answer: The rosary is meditation on the life of Christ with his mother, carried by repetition that is meant to occupy the surface of the mind. Distraction is not failure; noticing it and beginning again is the prayer. Ten minutes prayed badly is worth more than the perfect rosary you did not say.
